draft.title: Dangerous Magic
draft.intent: Magic creates persistent consequences for the caster.

rules.name: Casting Adds a Mark
rules.text: When a character casts magic, the game may give that character a lasting mark according to the casting procedure.

rules.name: Marks Persist
rules.text: A lasting mark remains on its caster until a game-specific rule removes or transforms it.

concepts.name: Caster
concepts.description: A character capable of casting magic.

concepts.name: Lasting Mark
concepts.description: A persistent consequence associated with a caster.

assumptions: Not every casting event necessarily creates a mark.
openQuestions: What determines when a mark is gained?
What effects do accumulated marks have?
exclusions: This draft does not define a dice system, spell list, or combat rule.
